items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: FR-01.28: a path wrapped over rows is ONE link; soft wrap (isWrapped) already joined since #562, now the app hard-wrap (Claude TUI newline at the last column) is joined by a conservative heuristic.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Pure read-only buffer scan; missing rows return undefined, row cap 20 returns no links.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No I/O added; activation and probe unchanged and run on the joined path through the same guards.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 9 unit tests (hard wrap, 3 rows, wide char, adjacent paths, prose/URL/indent negatives, soft wrap exact width, 3-row soft, cap) + 5 real-browser specs (soft/hard, row 1/2, Mission chip).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Row cells cached per call, walk bounded by 20 rows, only on hover of a row.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Scan extracted to terminalLogicalLine.ts; provider shrank to 89 lines; EmbeddedTerminal.tsx untouched.
